verdict: key consistent once the plaintext is corrected: 51 signs = 51 letters, 12 groups = 12 words, one letter per shape, one shape per letter; the corrected words also give the second wording (initial letters = رب احفظ ما وهبت) exactly
notes: Rows 5r l.12, 5r l.13, 5v l.1, 5v l.2 and a 4-sign column in the left margin of 5v beside l.1-2, written upward with the signs turned 90 degrees clockwise (S4 S5 S15 S1 from the bottom, then a turned divider at the top: the 'D ∴' above l.1 and the 'B' marks at the ends of l.1 and l.2 are this column). By eye 12+11+12+12+4 = 51 signs (record 13 x 4 = 52), 12 dividers (record 10). Record plaintext corrected from the groups: (1) word 2 is بحلب 'in Aleppo', not كلبا: S6 (Ʉ) is ح in حطوما as well, S7 (ш) is ل in المرصع and هالته, S5 is ب in بدره and تبهر; 6r names Halab the city as one of the hidden words; (2) احطوما is حطوما (5 signs; اسدا حطوما 'a smashing lion'); (3) وسطها النه is وسط هالته 'in the middle of its halo' (groups of 3 and 5; the page's 'هالنه' is هالته with the ت dots merged); (4) بدت تبهره is بدره تبهر (groups of 4 and 4; on the page 5v l.11 the ر and ه of بدره are written as the compiler read بدت, the last word ends in ر). Check from the riddle itself: 5v l.12 says the second wording is the prayer رب احفظ ما وهبت; the initial letters of the twelve corrected words are ر ب ا ح ف ظ م ا و ه ب ت = رب احفظ ما وهبت exactly, while the record's words give ك for ب (word 2) and ا for ح (word 4) and ا for ه (word 10). مجنى keeps its final ى (S3, the ي of رايت). The ن of مجنى (S18, slanting leg) and ب (S5, short vertical leg) are distinct shapes at 3x. The third and fourth wordings (Musa, Hamid) are not keyed here.
